Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
I should know the answer ot this one but I'll ask anyway and risk
embarassment.

If a minion takes 1 point of damage in the first strike resolution,
prevents with superior Skin of Rock and takes another point in the
second strike resolution, will the SoR apply to that damage too?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <36534F77...@lmco.com>, Quicksilver
<michae...@lmco.com> writes

>If a minion takes 1 point of damage in the first strike resolution,
>prevents with superior Skin of Rock and takes another point in the
>second strike resolution, will the SoR apply to that damage too?

No. After a strike resolution, excess damage prevention is forgotten.

--

> In article <36534F77...@lmco.com>, Quicksilver
> <michae...@lmco.com> writes
> >If a minion takes 1 point of damage in the first strike resolution,
> >prevents with superior Skin of Rock and takes another point in the
> >second strike resolution, will the SoR apply to that damage too?
>
> No. After a strike resolution, excess damage prevention is forgotten.

Right. Damage prevention is only good for the current damage, not
for future damage, unless card text says otherwise.
